payload.text:
Both defects are in `calc.ps1`:

1. **`Get-Total` subtracts instead of adding** (`calc.ps1:1`).  
   It returns `$a - $b`, so `Get-Total 7 5` returns `2`. `check.ps1:2` expects `12`, requiring `$a + $b`.

2. **`Get-Tax` adds the wrong amount** (`calc.ps1:2`).  
   It returns `$amount + 3`, so `Get-Tax 4` returns `7`. The check expects `8`, so the intended calculation is `$amount + 4`.

`check.ps1` correctly dot-sources `calc.ps1` and throws `CHECK-FAILED` when either result is wrong. No files were edited and no shell commands were run.

args.old_string:
function Get-Total($a, $b) { return $a - $b }
function Get-Tax($amount) { return $amount + 3 }
args.new_string:
function Get-Total($a, $b) { return $a + $b }
function Get-Tax($amount) { return $amount + 4 }
